## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant issues.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain anything not checked.

- [ ] Relevant lint/typecheck/test/build checks passed, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Browser changes were checked in the built extension; docs-only changes have valid links.
- [ ] English/Vietnamese labels and documentation were updated where relevant.
- [ ] Capture, permissions, storage, or clipboard changes are explained where relevant.

## Screenshots

For visible UI changes, include before/after images using neutral content. Otherwise remove this section.

## Risks or follow-up

Mention remaining limitations and manual checks needed. Remove this section if none.
